notes:
Telemetry analysis review, all sixteen items (T1-T16).

- Pit-exit laps are no longer counted as clean: the first lap after the pits is judged against the session's own flying start speed, so a slow merge no longer pollutes consistency and the personal-best history.
- A part lap can never be the session's "best"; a duplicated lap time carried over from the previous lap is dropped.
- Personal-best history and the setup highlights use clean full laps only.
- Corner tree: a corner losing a tenth a lap is never green; the typical lap (the median of your clean laps) gets its own row of lights beside the selected lap, and "Work on" quotes the typical lap, not the one lap you happen to have open.
- Brake, turn-in and gas marks are interpolated between samples, in the file engine and live, so the marks no longer jump by one sample step.
- Live sectors on the dashboard now sit at the reference's own sector boundaries; the dashboard ticks every 200 ms with a glance strip (delta, laps of fuel, ahead, behind) on phones.
- Dashboard tiles size their number to the tile, so a lap time is never cut to "1:53..."; on a phone the page is never wider than the screen.
- The corner tree is cached per session and reference (3.9 s to 0.1 s on reopen); opening a session records it to the career log even before a debrief.
- Phone companion: a corners card per session; the lap table folds part laps behind one line; the map legend sits under the map; deltas under 0.05 s are not shown.
